(b) Contractor shall bill Company as set forth in the relevant Statement of Work. Each invoice submitted by Contractor will provide supporting detail for the Services invoiced, including, to the extent applicable to a particular engagement, the dates of Services and hours worked at the applicable rate by Statement of Work. Invoices shall also include receipts or other supporting detail concerning related expenses within the billing cycle.</quote>
<parameter name="rationale">This is a time-and-materials consulting agreement with no audit, inspection or fee-verification right running against Clear Capital. Searches for audit, inspection, verification, records, books, monitoring and on-site/premises review returned no clause binding Company, and Sections 1, 3, 4, 5, 6 and 7 contain none. Fees are verified only through Contractor-supplied invoice detail (§ 3(b)), not through any examination of our records. The one access-related provision (§ 1(c), p0007) runs the other way, requiring Contractor's personnel to comply with our security and computer-system access policies. Because no audit right binds Customer, the frequency, notice, cost-allocation and no-system-access limits have nothing to attach to and the rule is satisfied by absence; we do not create an audit right merely to qualify it, as that would weaken us. No redline proposed.
